import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    df = inputs["invoices"].copy()

    amount = df["amount"]
    tax = df["tax"]
    due_date = df["due_date"]
    customer_ref = df["customer_ref"]

    amount_null = amount.isna()
    tax_null = tax.isna()

    r1 = amount_null | (amount < 0)
    r2 = tax_null | (tax < 0)
    r3 = (~amount_null) & (~tax_null) & (tax > amount * 0.5)
    r4 = due_date.isna()

    ref_null = customer_ref.isna()
    ref_trim_empty = customer_ref.apply(
        lambda x: isinstance(x, str) and x.strip() == ""
    )
    r5 = ref_null | ref_trim_empty

    reasons = pd.Series([[] for _ in range(len(df))], index=df.index)

    rule_defs = [
        (r1, "AMT_BAD"),
        (r2, "TAX_BAD"),
        (r3, "TAX_EXCESS"),
        (r4, "DUE_NULL"),
        (r5, "REF_EMPTY"),
    ]

    for mask, code in rule_defs:
        mask = mask.fillna(False)
        for idx in df.index[mask]:
            reasons.at[idx].append(code)

    reason_codes = reasons.apply(lambda lst: "|".join(lst))
    has_failure = reason_codes.str.len() > 0

    clean = df.loc[~has_failure].copy()
    rejects = df.loc[has_failure].copy()
    rejects["reason_codes"] = reason_codes.loc[has_failure]

    clean = clean.reset_index(drop=True)
    rejects = rejects.reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "invoices_clean": clean,
        "invoices_rejects": rejects,
    }
